svg.title: Elastic transitions conserve total energy, not longitudinal kinetic energy
svg.desc: Panel a shows an elastic same-direction transition at E=130 meV from mode one (blue) to mode two (gold). Their positive wavenumbers are 0.629 and 0.315 per nanometre. The teal arrow is a transition between states, not a real-space trajectory. Mode three (red dashed) is closed because its edge 143.5 meV exceeds E. Panel b accounts for the same total energy: mode one has transverse and axial kinetic energies 50.7 and 79.3 meV; mode two has 110.1 and 19.9 meV. In each stack the sum is 130 meV. No new scattering rate is inferred from this kinematic diagram.
svg.text: E = 130 meV · W = 10 nm · H = 8 nm
